0.2.2-rc.2.changelog:
> 上游版本 `dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2`　|　本仓库发布版本 `0.2.2-rc.2` [中文](#cn-v0.2.2-rc.2) | [English](#en-v0.2.2-rc.2)

新增功能

- Git Worktree 支持按分支、提交和文件类型审阅改动，并直接处理 GitHub 评审、同步已审阅进度和更新分支。 @LegGasai - SubAgent 支持具名与多层协作，AgentTeam 可按会话开启，共用成员与任务面板。 @Dudu-0223, @Yifffan - 桌面端支持在设置中切换正式版与开发版更新渠道。 @winewill ### 体验优化 - 改善代码审阅时的评论、文件导航与窄屏布局，减少查看大型改动时的卡顿，并放宽大型仓库创建工作树的等待时间。 @LegGasai - 改善多层子代理的浏览与任务协调，优先展示任务描述，支持逐层展开和读取失败后重试。 @Dudu-0223 - 优化左侧栏插件入口的收纳，不常用入口可移入“更多”，重新固定时保持原顺序。 @Yifffan - 简化个性化页面安装后的操作，移除“保留”按钮，统一使用撤销与恢复。 @ZiyaZhang - 改善自定义主题对通知、卡片、计划和任务等界面颜色的覆盖。 @turtle2099 - 改善页面缩放、平移及长列表场景下的菜单定位，保持菜单与触发位置对齐；自定义浮层需适配新定位接口。 @Stevring, @LegGasai - 改善暗色模式下文件树浮层的显示，使用背景层次区分面板，避免白色投影。 @turtle2099 - 改善在侧栏查找文件的体验，支持按名称或路径搜索，并可调整排除规则与隐藏文件显示。 @yudshj - 改善侧栏长列表的浏览与拖动体验，插件导航和会话列表共用滚动区域，工作区工具栏保持可见。 @Yifffan - 优化从会话打开工作目录的操作，统一“在应用中打开”菜单，并改善窄屏使用体验。 @Yifffan - 加快文件右键菜单的打开；关联应用查询较慢时，先提供默认应用入口。 @yudshj - 向上回看聊天时自动加载更早消息，优先保持阅读位置，并保留手动加载和重试入口。 @imccyu - 改善聊天过程的可查看性，可展开工作区指令、技能目录等信息，了解模型收到的上下文。 @turtle2099 - 改善补丁编辑的回执，折叠状态下也可查看修改的文件，并在成功后直接打开。 @sjw1231 - 优化会话首页的交互动画。 @ZiyaZhang - 改善会话恢复或压缩后的上下文提示，明确当前运行信息与旧信息的替换关系。 @kermanx - 改善聊天中代码差异的阅读，显示增删行颜色，并按文件语言高亮。 @mektpoy - 改善粘贴图片和文件的体验，未聚焦输入框时也可粘贴到最近使用的可用输入框或主对话。 @std4453 - 改善暂停、恢复定时任务时的操作反馈，保持按钮焦点与显示稳定，避免重复操作。 @turtle2099 - 优化目标栏的操作排列与按钮间距，统一为“编辑、清除、暂停或恢复”。 @turtle2099 - 优化模型请求失败后的重试设置，可在模型设置中选择重试条件、次数和等待时间。 @turtle2099 - 改善临时请求失败后的恢复操作，可直接点击“继续生成”，无需另写消息。 @LegGasai - 改善 API Key 的管理，已保存密钥以掩码显示，支持整体替换或清除，不显示完整旧密钥。 @Magolor - 优化多问题检索，单次网页搜索默认支持最多 10 个查询和 10 个来源。 @turtle2099 - 改善 Agent 终端的可见性与接管体验，命令在侧栏终端运行，用户输入即可接管；允许读取的用户终端内容会进入模型与会话记录。 @LegGasai - 优化批量查询文件、任务和资源时的执行效率，更多只读工具可并行运行，结果仍按调用顺序返回。 @turtle2099 - 改善桌面更新下载时的进度显示，可点击下载百分比或“检查更新”查看状态。 @winewill ### 问题修复 - 修复 PR 更新后审阅差异与提交行号不一致的问题，并改善大量评审讨论的统计。 @LegGasai - 修复只有 SSH 凭据时无法查看私有 Git 插件详情的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复可选插件加载失败导致整个 Web 页面无法启动的问题；必需插件失败仍会提示。 @imccyu - 修复已启用但未成功加载的插件容易被误认为正在运行的问题，明确显示“未运行”及原因。 @turtle1999 - 修复 PTC 中重复等待子代理消息时，同一条消息反复触发唤醒的问题。 @Dudu-0223 - 修复浏览特殊文件名或扩展名时，文件树视图崩溃的问题。 @LegGasai - 修复“未分组”会话中显示无效“新建会话”按钮的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复复制聊天公式时出现乱码的问题，同一条 Markdown 内容中的公式可复制为 TeX 源码。 @turtle2099 - 修复查看 Perl 代码时，正则表达式导致后续内容高亮错误的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复聊天更新出错后，历史加载和新消息显示持续卡住的问题。 @Magolor - 改善重复创建会话分支时的标题编号，跳过已用编号，减少同名会话。 @turtle2099 - 修复停止任务或关闭会话时，部分错误导致任务未中止或资源提前释放的问题。 @liukx0205 - 修复发送消息或准备附件期间重试请求，导致同一消息被重复提交的问题。 @liukx0205 - 修复中文目标栏混淆“待继续”与“已暂停”状态的问题。 @imccyu - 修复桌面端多次启动后，因鉴权信息累积而无法启动的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 Windows 通过短路径启动命令行时，无法保存欢迎页确认的问题。 @winewill - 修复 macOS 窗口拖动与粘贴快捷键问题，以及 Windows 暗色模式启动白闪。 @yxy72, @winewill, @turtle2099 - 改善 Windows 更新安装期间的反馈，显示安装状态窗口，减少重启过程中的无提示等待。 @winewill - 修复移动端 Safari 在展开屏幕或切换视口后，聊天文字被额外放大的问题，保留用户主动缩放。 @Saafo - 修复 Linux 存在长期后台进程时，会话加载与新建变慢的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复会话中移除或替换工具后，部分模型拒绝继续请求的问题。 @Tuyixiang - 通过 Anthropic Messages 接入时，历史前缀变化后省略失效的签名 thinking，减少压缩后持续请求失败。 @turtle2099 - 修复部分模型网关错误被误报为“API 密钥无效”的问题，使重试按实际响应状态处理。 @LegGasai - 修复在 DSH 用户目录中配置 DeepSeek 端点后无法启动的问题；项目目录中的环境配置仍不能覆盖端点。 @LegGasai - 修复连续浏览多页 PDF 时加载越来越慢、快速翻页卡顿的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复使用 Inspector 查看较大的 Cordis 树时，快照接近上限可能导致服务退出的问题。 @turtle2099 ### 其他变更 - 网页搜索默认改用 DeepSeek Search API，搜索与获取可分别选择计费账号或 API Key；旧提供方和自定义配置需按升级指南调整。 @yudshj - 归档会话默认清理符合条件的 Git 工作树，保留分支与提交；需保留本地目录时请关闭清理，自定义配置与 Forge 插件需迁移。 @LegGasai - AgentTeam 改用统一的具名子代理，中断工具默认关闭；自定义插件与 SDK 集成需迁移，共享会话的进程须同步升级。 @Dudu-0223 - SDK 可通过配置为新会话默认开启团队协作，恢复已有会话时保留原选择。 @Dudu-0223 - 允许插件动态注册和移除 MCP 服务，并查询状态、重启或探测连接，无需用户逐项维护服务配置。 @LegGasai - 插件可按语言扩展聊天代码块的显示，未匹配或渲染失败时回退为普通代码块。 @imccyu - 插件索引可提供 GitHub Star 和 npm 周下载量，默认仍按索引提供的顺序排列。 @turtle1999 - Creator 的开发指引统一到 dsh-doc，用于定制 DSH 并查阅当前版本资料；引用旧技能名称或路径的扩展需迁移。 @turtle1999 - 自定义模型提供方支持 Gemini 原生接口，可获取模型列表并设置推理等级。 @turtle2099 - 模型请求的 User-Agent 增加启动配置标记，便于服务端区分桌面端、Web、命令行与 SDK 请求。 @imccyu - 调整账号通知，支持产品公告等消息并随界面语言更新；已有登录保留，自定义账号插件与配置需迁移。 @lsdsjy - PTC 按运行时限限制工具调用总量，超限会终止代码并清空保留状态，已完成的操作不会撤销。 @kermanx - Session 支持批量追加事件，日志格式不变；自定义追加接口的包装代码需适配批量调用。 @liukx0205 - 工具失败提供更明确的错误类型与代码，便于定位问题；依赖旧错误分类的插件和 SDK 集成需同步适配。 @sjw1231 - 调整 Computer Use 的窗口操作、键盘控制和授权，默认不移动系统鼠标；自定义脚本与 helper 需同步升级。 @CreatixChu, @Tuyixiang, @Dudu-0223 - Office 改用原生工具，Web 与 SDK 均可加载技能；旧包和技能需迁移，文档解析在 DSH 主进程中运行，不受命令行沙箱保护。 @yudshj - Windows 的额外目录授权仅供文件工具使用，不扩大终端或 PTC 的访问范围；相关沙箱扩展需迁移。 @Tuyixiang - 调整 LiveShare 的多会话分享与插件授权，旧授权需重新配置；PTC 可访问分享目录之外，仅应分享给可信任的人。 @mektpoy - npm 安装与桌面端随附对应版本的源码和文档，方便查阅与开发扩展；Python 单文件运行时不包含这些资源。 @turtle1999 - 升级 Zod 至 4.6.6、Stagehand 至 4.4.0；Stagehand 改为自动发现扩展，旧 extensionId 配置不再生效。 @imccyu

New Features

- Git Worktree supports reviewing changes by branch, commit, and file category, with GitHub reviews, synchronized viewed-file progress, and branch updates directly in DSH. by @LegGasai - SubAgent supports named, multi-level collaboration, while AgentTeam can be enabled per session with a shared member and task panel. by @Dudu-0223, @Yifffan - Desktop settings now let you switch between stable and development update channels. by @winewill ### Improvements - Improve commenting, file navigation, and narrow-screen layouts during code review, reduce lag when viewing large changes, and allow more time to create worktrees in large repositories. by @LegGasai - Improve browsing and coordinating nested subagents, prioritizing task descriptions and supporting incremental expansion and retries after failed reads. by @Dudu-0223 - Improve sidebar plugin organization: move infrequently used entries into More and restore them without changing their original order. by @Yifffan - Simplify actions after installing personalized pages, replacing Keep with Undo and Restore. by @ZiyaZhang - Improve custom-theme coverage for notifications, cards, plans, tasks, and other interface colors. by @turtle2099 - Improve menu positioning during page zooming, panning, and browsing long lists, keeping menus aligned with their triggers; custom panels need to adopt the new positioning API. by @Stevring, @LegGasai - Improve dark-theme file-tree panels with layered backgrounds instead of white shadows. by @turtle2099 - Improve file discovery in the sidebar with name and path search, exclusion rules, and hidden-file controls. by @yudshj - Improve browsing and dragging in long sidebar lists, with plugin navigation and sessions sharing a scroll area and workspace controls remaining visible. by @Yifffan - Streamline opening a session's working directory through a consistent Open in menu, with improved narrow-screen usability. by @Yifffan - Open file context menus faster; when application lookup is slow, offer a default-app action first. by @yudshj - Automatically load earlier messages when scrolling up through chat, prioritizing reading-position stability while retaining manual loading and retry controls. by @imccyu - Make chat activity easier to inspect by expanding workspace instructions, skill catalogs, and other context received by the model. by @turtle2099 - Improve patch-edit receipts by listing affected files even when collapsed and allowing them to be opened after successful edits. by @sjw1231 - Improve interaction animations on the session home screen. by @ZiyaZhang - Improve context reminders after session resume or compaction by clarifying how current runtime information replaces older information. by @kermanx - Improve reading code diffs in chat with added and removed row colors and per-file syntax highlighting. by @mektpoy - Improve image and file pasting without a focused composer, routing content to the most recently used available composer or the main conversation. by @std4453 - Improve feedback when pausing or resuming scheduled tasks, keeping focus and appearance stable while preventing duplicate actions. by @turtle2099 - Refine goal-bar action order and spacing to Edit, Clear, and Pause or Resume. by @turtle2099 - Improve model-request retry settings with configurable retry conditions, counts, and wait times in model settings. by @turtle2099 - Make recovery from transient request failures easier with Continue generating, without requiring another message. by @LegGasai - Improve API-key management with masked previews and full replacement or removal, without revealing the complete saved key. by @Magolor - Improve multi-question research with up to 10 queries and 10 sources per web-search call by default. by @turtle2099 - Make Agent terminals visible in the sidebar and let users take over by typing; user-terminal content that agents are permitted to read enters model context and session records. by @LegGasai - Improve batch file, task, and resource queries by allowing more read-only tools to run concurrently while returning results in call order. by @turtle2099 - Improve Desktop update progress displays, with status available from the download percentage or Check for updates. by @winewill ### Bug Fixes - Fix PR updates causing displayed diffs to use mismatched commit line numbers, and improve counts for large numbers of review threads. by @LegGasai - Fix private Git plugin details failing to load for users with SSH-only credentials. by @turtle2099 - Fix optional plugin failures preventing the entire Web app from starting; required-plugin failures remain visible errors. by @imccyu - Fix enabled but unloaded plugins appearing to run, clearly showing Not running and the reason. by @turtle1999 - Fix repeated waits for subagent messages within PTC waking repeatedly for the same message. by @Dudu-0223 - Fix file-tree crashes when browsing special filenames or extensions. by @LegGasai - Fix a nonfunctional New Session button appearing in the Ungrouped session header. by @turtle2099 - Fix garbled formula copying in chat, copying formulas within a single Markdown document as TeX source. by @turtle2099 - Fix Perl regular expressions incorrectly coloring subsequent code. by @turtle2099 - Fix history loading and new-message displays remaining stuck after a chat-update error. by @Magolor - Improve title numbering when repeatedly branching a session, skipping used numbers to reduce duplicate names. by @turtle2099 - Fix some errors during task cancellation or session shutdown leaving work running or releasing resources prematurely. by @liukx0205 - Fix retried requests during message submission or attachment preparation submitting the same message more than once. by @liukx0205 - Fix the Chinese goal bar confusing goals awaiting continuation with paused goals. by @imccyu - Fix accumulated authentication data preventing Desktop startup after repeated launches. by @turtle2099 - Fix welcome-screen confirmation failing to save when the Windows CLI is launched through a short path. by @winewill - Fix macOS window dragging and paste shortcuts, and white flashes when starting Windows in dark mode. by @yxy72, @winewill, @turtle2099 - Improve feedback during Windows update installation with an installation-status window, reducing unexplained waiting during restarts. by @winewill - Fix mobile Safari enlarging chat text beyond the configured font size when unfolding or changing the viewport, while preserving manual page zoom. by @Saafo - Fix long-running background processes slowing session loading and creation on Linux. by @turtle2099 - Fix some models rejecting further requests after tools are removed or replaced in a session. by @Tuyixiang - For Anthropic Messages connections, omit invalid signed thinking after history-prefix changes to reduce persistent request failures after compaction. by @turtle2099 - Fix some model-gateway failures being misreported as invalid API keys, allowing retries to follow the actual response status. by @LegGasai - Fix startup failure after configuring DeepSeek endpoints in the DSH user directory; project environment settings still cannot override these endpoints. by @LegGasai - Fix progressively slower loading and rapid-page-navigation stalls when browsing multi-page PDFs. by @turtle2099 - Fix inspecting large Cordis trees potentially terminating the service when snapshots approach the size limit. by @turtle2099 ### Chores - Web search now defaults to DeepSeek Search API, with separate account or API-key billing choices for Search and Fetch; migrate older providers and custom settings using the upgrade guide. by @yudshj - Archiving sessions cleans up eligible Git worktrees by default while preserving branches and commits; disable cleanup to retain local directories, and migrate custom configuration and Forge plugins. by @LegGasai - AgentTeam uses unified named subagents, with the interrupt tool disabled by default; migrate custom plugins and SDK integrations and upgrade all processes sharing session storage together. by @Dudu-0223 - SDK configuration can enable Team collaboration by default for new sessions while preserving the saved choice when resuming existing sessions. by @Dudu-0223 - Plugins can dynamically register and remove MCP servers, query their status, restart them, and probe connections without requiring users to maintain each server configuration manually. by @LegGasai - Plugins can extend chat code-block rendering by language, falling back to ordinary code blocks when no renderer matches or rendering fails. by @imccyu - Plugin indexes can provide GitHub stars and weekly npm downloads while keeping the order supplied by the index as the default. by @turtle1999 - Creator guidance consolidates into dsh-doc for customizing DSH and consulting current-version resources; extensions referencing old skill names or paths need migration. by @turtle1999 - Custom model providers support the native Gemini API, including model discovery and reasoning-level settings. by @turtle2099 - Model-request User-Agent headers include the active profile, helping servers distinguish Desktop, Web, CLI, and SDK requests. by @imccyu - Account notifications support announcements and refresh with the interface language; existing sign-ins are retained, while custom account plugins and configuration need migration. by @lsdsjy - PTC limits total tool calls according to its runtime budget; exceeding the limit terminates the code and clears retained state without undoing completed operations. by @kermanx - Session supports batched event appends without changing the log format; custom append wrappers need to support batch calls. by @liukx0205 - Tool failures provide clearer error types and codes for diagnosis; plugins and SDK integrations relying on older classifications need updating. by @sjw1231 - Adjust Computer Use window operations, keyboard control, and authorization, keeping the system pointer still by default; upgrade custom scripts and helpers together. by @CreatixChu, @Tuyixiang, @Dudu-0223 - Office uses native tools, with skills available in Web and SDK sessions; migrate old packages and skills. Document parsing runs in the DSH host process outside the shell sandbox. by @yudshj - Windows extra-directory grants apply only to file tools, not terminal or PTC access; related sandbox extensions need migration. by @Tuyixiang - Adjust LiveShare multi-session sharing and plugin authorization; reconfigure old grants. PTC can access files outside the shared directory, so share only with trusted people. by @mektpoy - npm installations and Desktop include matching source code and documentation for reference and extension development; Python single-file runtimes exclude these resources. by @turtle1999 - Upgrade Zod to 4.6.6 and Stagehand to 4.4.0; Stagehand automatically discovers extensions, and the old extensionId setting no longer takes effect. by @imccyu Full Changelog: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1...dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2 --- 飞牛打包层改动（与上游版本无关）见 [Release 说明](https://github.com/yoqie/FFFFFFFFNNNN/releases/tag/dsh-0.2.2-rc.2)。
0.2.2-rc.2.release_note: DSH v0.2.2-rc.2 飞牛 fnOS 自动构建（amd64/arm64）。

desc: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）飞牛NAS版：跟随上游 deepseek-harness 自动构建，amd64/arm64 双架构原生安装包，飞牛桌面一键打开。
